Who We Are

The OS for
intelligent travel.

ORN — Orchestrated Rhythms of Nature — has built the operating system for intelligent travel. We orchestrate every flight, hotel, experience and journey on a single unified platform, powered by our proprietary NX/OS intelligence layer. Backed by HCL Group — a $60 billion enterprise — ORN has the scale and technology depth to be the definitive global travel platform.

UAE is Open. ORN is With You. We are not a fair-weather partner. We maintained our UAE product, our agent relationships and our contracting infrastructure throughout the recovery period — and we are stepping forward with full investment across all seven emirates in 2026.

distinct destinations.

Each emirate has its own character, its own traveller profile and its own hotel opportunity. ORN's 2026 programme covers all of them — with dedicated distribution, agent engagement and marketing activation tailored to every destination's unique proposition.

Primary · ~65% of ORN UAE Revenue
Dubai
ORN's anchor UAE destination. City luxury, beach resorts, ultra-luxury towers, desert escapes and family mega-resorts. India, UK, USA and Australia all actively booking Dubai product daily through our 80,000+ agent network. Every segment, every price point.

City Luxury · Beach · Ultra-Luxury · Family Resorts · Desert · Boutique · MICE
Growing Priority · Capital City
Abu Dhabi
World-class cultural attractions, Formula 1, Yas Island entertainment and premium Saadiyat beach resorts. Strong FIT and MICE demand from India and UK travellers. ORN actively growing Abu Dhabi allocation and product depth in 2026.
Key Product
Yas Island · Saadiyat Beach · City Luxury · MICE · Cultural Tourism · F1 Packages
Fast Growth · Nature & Adventure
Ras Al Khaimah
The UAE's fastest-growing hospitality destination. Mountain resorts, pristine beaches, adventure tourism and premium wellness. Strong appeal for UK, European and Indian travellers seeking an authentic alternative. ORN's RAK pipeline actively expanding in 2026.
Key Product
Jebel Jais Resorts · Beach · Wellness · Adventure · Nature Retreats
Cultural Capital · Value Segment
Sharjah
UNESCO World Book Capital and the UAE's cultural heart. Strong appeal for culturally-minded Indian and GCC travellers. Value and mid-market hotel segment with easy proximity to Dubai. Served through ORN's India FIT and group agent network daily.
Key Product
City Hotels · Cultural Tourism · Group Travel · Budget-Midscale
East Coast · Beach & Diving
Fujairah
The UAE's east coast gem — Indian Ocean beaches, pristine diving, mountain backdrops and a growing resort scene. Popular for short breaks from Dubai and as a standalone destination for nature and wellness seekers. Active in ORN's UAE beach product portfolio.
Key Product
Beach Resorts · Diving · Wellness · Short Breaks · Nature
Emerging · Authentic UAE
Ajman & UMQ
Authentic, unhurried UAE — traditional souks, heritage sites, mangrove eco-tourism and affordable beach access. Growing appeal for culturally curious Indian travellers and budget-conscious family groups seeking real UAE character beyond the glitz.

Connection Roadmap

Three phases.
One clear path.

ORN's connection strategy is structured to give hotel partners immediate access from Day 1, with a clear commercial roadmap to direct integration as volumes grow. No barriers, no delays — we start from the moment the partnership is confirmed.

1
Immediate

DMC Route — Active Day 1

Working through established Dubai DMCs — Elevate, Arabian Adventures, Desert Gate or Travco — all connected to Synexis. Live inventory and best available rates from day one of partnership.

2
Short Term

Direct Static Contract

Once volume projections are confirmed, a direct static contract is established. Our India, USA and Australia pipelines are structured to meet the volume thresholds required across all UAE property categories.

3
Scale

Direct Synexis API Integration

TripFactory's API-first architecture enables direct system integration as volumes grow — eliminating intermediary margin and giving full real-time distribution visibility across all UAE properties.
